Request: Disable the password for the `service' user
Initial states: Both: service user exists. baseline: unlocked password hash; adversarial: locked password hash.
Playbook:

- name: Candidate playbook
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Disable the password for service user
    user:
      name: service
      password: !secret service_password
      update_password: always
    when: service_password is defined
    become: yes
